args.body:
- Spot freight rates fell 9% this quarter while contract rates held steady, widening the gap between spot and contract pricing.
- Fuel surcharges now track weekly diesel prices, making surcharge costs more responsive to fuel market movements.
- Shippers who split their volume across three carriers paid the least, per the companion piece (https://insights.corvid.example/freight/companion).
args.title: Freight Pricing Insights — Corvid Blog + Companion
